sections.heading: What is a managed website for a roofing company?
body: A managed website for a roofing company is a professionally designed website that SynergyFirst Digital hosts, maintains and supports for one monthly fee, with no upfront design fee. It is built around how people look for roofing and exterior work: repair, replacement, the area you cover, and a fast way to call or request an estimate.
Plans start at $249 per month with no activation fee, and every business can see a free, private preview before paying.

sections.heading: Why roofing websites lose jobs they should win
sections.intro: A roof is a big, often urgent purchase, and homeowners compare quickly. These are the gaps we see most often.

items.title: The phone number is hard to find
items.body: When a roof is leaking after a storm, a number buried in a menu sends the homeowner to the next company.

items.title: Repair, replacement and exterior work are mixed together
items.body: A small leak and a full replacement are different decisions. Without clear paths for each, visitors are unsure you handle theirs.

items.title: Customers cannot see completed work
items.body: Without clear photos of finished roofs and exteriors, it is hard for a homeowner to judge the quality of what you do.

items.title: The service area is unclear
items.body: If visitors cannot quickly tell whether you cover their town, they do not enquire.

items.title: No easy way to ask for an estimate
items.body: Most roofing jobs are priced after a look at the roof. A short request form captures customers who would rather write than call.

items.title: Trust is left to chance
items.body: Licence and insurance details, warranty terms, reviews and past work belong where customers look for reassurance.

sections.heading: What we build into a roofing website
sections.intro: Every site is custom-designed around how your customers choose a roofing and exterior company.

items.title: Click-to-call on every page
items.body: Your number stays one tap away on phones, so urgent customers can reach you without searching.

items.title: Separate paths for repair, replacement and exterior work
items.body: Clear service sections so each visitor lands on the job they need, with a call or estimate request beside it.

items.title: Storm and leak options
items.body: Give urgent jobs their own route, so a homeowner with a leak or storm damage knows what to do next.

items.title: Service-area clarity
items.body: State where you work, so visitors can see straight away that you cover their location.

items.title: A home for photos, reviews and credentials
items.body: Space for completed work, warranty terms and the trust signals you can genuinely show, placed where customers look for reassurance.

items.title: A simple estimate-request form
items.body: A short, accessible form where customers describe the job, so you can plan the visit.
